summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Education, in coordination with the Secretary of Health and Human Services, to award competitive grants to eligible partnerships to establish, expand, or support career and technical education programs in early childhood education.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes competitive grants to establish, support, or expand career and technical education programs in early childhood education, which implies an increase in government spending to fund these grants.

The entire bill is dedicated to establishing a grant program for career and technical education in early childhood education, aiming to improve the early childhood education workforce. This directly involves more spending on public education initiatives.

The bill aims to strengthen the early childhood education workforce, which indirectly supports the social safety net by improving access to and quality of childcare services, a critical component for working families and child development.
